functions.source: function read(relative,deployment=false){const file=path.join(finalRoot,relative);if(typeof relative!=='string'||relative.startsWith('/')||relative.split('/').some(v=>!v||v==='.'||v==='..'))fail();let at=finalRoot;for(const part of relative.split('/')){const d=fs.lstatSync(at);if(!d.isDirectory()||d.isSymbolicLink()||deployment&&(d.uid!==0||d.gid!==0||(d.mode&0o022)!==0))fail();at=path.join(at,part)}const before=fs.lstatSync(file);if(!before.isFile()||before.isSymbolicLink()||before.nlink!==1||before.size<1||before.size>16777216||fs.realpathSync(file)!==file||deployment&&(before.uid!==0||before.gid!==0||(before.mode&0o222)!==0))fail();const bytes=fs.readFileSync(file),after=fs.lstatSync(file);if(['dev','ino','size','mtimeMs','ctimeMs','uid','gid','mode'].some(k=>before[k]!==after[k])||bytes.length!==before.size||bytes.includes(0)||!Buffer.from(bytes.toString('utf8')).equals(bytes))fail();return bytes}
